title: v1_120
content: # Visual Studio Code 1.120 Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/vs-code), [X](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=533687), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/vscode.dev) --- _Release date: May 13, 2026_ --- Welcome to the 1.120 release of Visual Studio Code. This release brings the Agents window to Stable, improves BYOK model visibility and control, and adds Markdown quality-of-life improvements and agent safety features. Here are the highlights for this release: * [Agents window in Stable](#orchestrate-tasks-across-projects-with-the-agents-window-preview): Work in an agents-first way across all your projects with the new Agents window. * [BYOK improvements](#language-models): Track and optimize token usage and configure thinking effort for your BYOK models. * [Markdown improvements](#languages): Review Markdown content instead of syntax with Markdown preview for diffs. * [Command risk assessment](#risk-assessment-for-terminal-commands-experimental): Assess the risk of terminal commands before they run. * [Token optimization](#terminal-tool-output-compression-preview): Reduce context window usage by compressing large terminal output. Happy Coding! ---
